sentences.en: The data had been presented misleadingly.

sentences.en: These bats are sometimes misleadingly referred to as 'flying foxes'.

sentences.en: It misleadingly marginalizes both the centrality of the Church and classicism, the dominant artistic trend of the period.

sentences.en: That is, high productivity can lead to a misleadingly high ratio.
